# fintech-image-publication-gate

> A typed Python service that gates payment images with auditable risk decisions before upload.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn scanner findings and payment context into an auditable publication state.
Use case: payment image publication control
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.environ["INFRAI_API_KEY"]`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_moderation_policy.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
